title: Archive (tar.bz2) model downloads with streaming extraction
description: The NPU speech model is only published as a 422 MB `.tar.bz2` archive. Teach the downloader to stream such an archive and extract only the listed files while downloading, verifying each by size (goal 1).
steps: Add `commonsCompress = "1.27.1"` and library `commons-compress = { module = "org.apache.commons:commons-compress", version.ref = "commonsCompress" }` to `gradle/libs.versions.toml`; `implementation(libs.commons.compress)` in `app/build.gradle.kts`.

In `models/ModelCatalog.kt` add `data class ModelArchive(val url: String, val sizeBytes: Long, val rootDir: String)` and a field `val archive: ModelArchive? = null` on `ModelBundle` (when set, `files` describe the extracted files and their `url` is ""). Add `val downloadBytes: Long get() = archive?.sizeBytes ?: totalBytes`.

In `ModelDownloader.download`: bytesTotal = sum over bundles of (archive bundles: `archive.sizeBytes`; others: sizes of their not-yet-installed files, as today, with installed files counted as done). For an archive bundle that is not installed: GET `archive.url` (non-2xx → `ModelDownloadException("HTTP <code> for <rootDir>")`); wrap the body stream in a small counting `FilterInputStream` that reports compressed bytes read for Progress; read it with `TarArchiveInputStream(BZip2CompressorInputStream(BufferedInputStream(counting, 1 shl 16)))`. For each entry: strip a leading `./` and then `rootDir + "/"`; if the remaining path equals a listed `fileName`, write it to `<target>.part`, check the size (`Size mismatch for <fileName>: expected X, got Y`, delete the .part), and rename. Skip all other entries. After the archive ends, throw `ModelDownloadException("Archive is missing <fileName>")` for any listed file not written. Already-installed archive bundles are skipped entirely (no request).

Extend `models/ModelDownloaderTest.kt`: build a small `.tar.bz2` in the test with `TarArchiveOutputStream(BZip2CompressorOutputStream(ByteArrayOutputStream()))` containing `root/a.bin` (1000 bytes), `root/sub/b.bin` (500 bytes) and `root/extra.txt`, and serve it with `MockWebServer`.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: archive bundle with files `a.bin` (1000) and `sub/b.bin` (500) → both extracted to the bundle dir with exact sizes, `extra.txt` not written, no `.part` files, last event Completed
Test: archive missing a listed file → ModelDownloadException with message `Archive is missing sub/b.bin`
Test: a listed file with the wrong size in the archive → message starting `Size mismatch`
Test: last Progress for an archive-only download has bytesDone == bytesTotal == the archive's byte length
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes (OnlineRecognizer, OnlineStream, OfflineSpeakerDiarization, SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, ...) in unit tests; plain `*Config` data classes are fine.
